5170-6132-8227-8292.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
5170-6132-8227-8292.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Loot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat.

443-2403-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-2403-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1308-3129-4365-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
1308-3129-4365-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

553-1470-6555.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar.
In response, cast Hinder by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Stunt Double each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-1129-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-3499.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1368-4289-6321-6791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4289-6321-6791.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

225-3875-5856-7514.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Food.
You have a basic Forest in your library or control a land that can tap to produce {G}.
225-3875-5856-7514.description:
Activate a Food using Dawntreader Elk's ability by paying {G} and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food token and untapping a land.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat.

4613-5310-5477-5627-7297.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-5310-5477-5627-7297.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5310-5477-5627-7297.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

1453-3967-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-3967-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

856-3967-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

582-1409-6751.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve both Brazen Freebooter triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2366-3512-5702-6791.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-5702-6791.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-6773-6968.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2292-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2724-3080-4608-6568.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-6568.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

4067-4249-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-4249-5672.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green or blue is at least six.
4067-4249-5672.description:
Activate Nykthos's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {G} or six {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2440-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Insect you control.
Repeat.

413-6431--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Celes trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1636-1648-3143-5696.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-1648-3143-5696.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Nissa of Shadowed Boughs trigger.
Resolve the Nissa of Shadowed Boughs trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2511-4871-5544-6011.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
2511-4871-5544-6011.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1049-4050-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least three times this game.
1049-4050-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Jirina.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Human Soldiers, adding {3}.
Repeat.
If you've cast your commander from the command zone at least four times, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and mana.

147-3645-5147.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4613-4968-5616.notablePrerequisites: Strong has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4968-5616.description:
Activate Strong using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Strong.
Strong triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to get three rad counters.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Strong using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 4 as desired.
4613-4968-5616.notes: This combo typically wins with infinite damage, but if the game isn't over by your next precombat main phase, your rad counters will trigger, causing you to mill any number of cards and gain a large amount of life (or lose that amount if Strong has left the battlefield).

3790-4753.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
3790-4753.description:
At the beginning of each of your upkeeps, Mystic Barrier and Clever Impersonator trigger, choosing "left" for Mystic Barrier and "right" for Clever Impersonator.
As long as there are three or more players in the game, creatures cannot attack.

1282-2131-2178-3185-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Serrated Biskelion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Serrated Biskelion.
Evernight Shade does not have more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
1282-2131-2178-3185-4050.description:
Activate Serrated Biskelion by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on it and Evernight Shade.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Evernight Shade, adding one mana of any color.
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability and Serrated Biskelion trigger.
Resolve the Serrated Biskelion trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Evernight Shade trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Evernight Shade leaves your graveyard, Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Serrated Biskelion.
Repeat.

1366-1368-1414.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
1366-1368-1414.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U/B}.
Cast Glimpse the Unthinkable from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill ten cards.
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U/B}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-2645-4091.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2645-4091.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards, or use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1004-1339-1689.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1004-1339-1689.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Rumor Gatherer, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
